Dependabot security updates (repository setting) were enabled 2026-09-22 and opened #97 (mlx 0.29.3 -> 0.29.4) and #98 (transformers 5.0.0rc1 -> 5.10.1) against tools/mlx-smoke/requirements.lock.txt; both failed macos-profile (runs 35815152321, 35815162857) because that lock is uv-compiled with hashes and an --exclude-newer cutoff from requirements.in and hardware-profile-smoke.yml recompiles and diffs it. The fix landed as a reviewed relock instead (#99). A pip version-update entry would repeat that failure weekly for every uv-compiled lock, and the curl-downloaded CI binaries still have no manifest Dependabot parses; catalog-freshness.yml's pin-drift table covers those. Overturn: a Dependabot pip/uv PR that passes the repository's recompile-and-diff check on a real lock.
